evidence.support_text: Boyland and Chasseaud (1967) investigated the enzyme-catalysed conjugation of glutathione with α,β-unsaturated compounds including cinnamaldehyde. Rat liver supernatant fractions were used; equal concentrations of GSH and 3 mM cinnamaldehyde were incubated in 0.2 M orthophosphate buffer, pH 6.5 at 25°C for 2 min. Cinnamaldehyde produced detectable activity equivalent to 45 µM of sulfhydryl lost per minute per gram of tissue, confirmed by paper chromatography.
